intent: A person starting from an empty machine can understand the mission, run the product, trace one action through the code, make one small change, and prove it, without private coaching.
rule: Every check starts false. A check may only be set true by a recorded observation bound to a real artifact. Never hand-edit a check to true. The agent proposes; the agent does not approve.

checks.claim: A cold-start walkthrough was executed and its friction recorded without repairing anything during the pass.
checks.evidence: harness/journey/baseline-2026-07-24.json — 7 friction records (3 P0) from executed probes; notRepaired:true. Boundary: instrumented probe, NOT a fresh-human study.

checks.claim: repo-map.json is derived from source by a generator and a drift check fails when it is stale.
checks.evidence: src/lib/repo-map.mjs derives the map from the CLI dispatch, schemas, modules and package.json; repo-map.json committed; test/repo-tour.test.mjs test 4 fails when the committed map is stale (it caught real staleness during this build).

checks.claim: START_HERE.md answers every blocking question the baseline actually recorded, not a speculative list.
checks.evidence: START_HERE.md answers F1 (install before first command), F3 (single entry point + five parts), F7 (docs/ are reference not onboarding) and links the glossary for F2. README now points to it in line 3 and installs deps before the first CLI command.

checks.claim: GLOSSARY.md defines every term the baseline recorded as undefined on first contact.
checks.evidence: GLOSSARY.md defines all 11 terms F2 recorded plus 6 more met next; test/copy-audit.test.mjs test 1 asserts undefinedTerms is empty against the real repo.

checks.claim: nodekit tour runs the walkthrough and verifies each step actually works rather than narrating it.
checks.evidence: nodekit tour verifies 4 steps against disk (node version, dependency resolution, five architecture parts, trace targets) and labels unverifiable steps [note] with passed:null. test 1.

checks.claim: nodekit tour reports failure when a step genuinely breaks; it cannot report success for an unobserved step.
checks.evidence: test/repo-tour.test.mjs test 2: against a corrupted repo missing the named parts, tour exits 1, passed:false, and the failing step names the recovery.

checks.claim: A vocabulary map exists binding internal terms to user-facing terms.
checks.evidence: src/lib/copy-audit.mjs VOCABULARY binds 17 internal terms to reader-facing wording.

checks.claim: The copy audit fails on undefined jargon in user-facing copy, proven by a corpus that must fail.
checks.evidence: test/copy-audit.test.mjs tests 2 and 3: undefined jargon blocks, and defined-but-unreachable jargon blocks. Test 4 proves identifiers in code/paths/links are not false-flagged.

checks.claim: A recorded friction record can become a candidate repair judged by the existing gym and recorded in the ledger, with no new parallel subsystem.
No schema or module was added that duplicates interaction-flow, human-study-event, builder-gym, or fresh-user-study.
Full test suite, typecheck, and evolution verify pass on the branch.
